prompt:
Our Finpay backend has been showing latency spikes and memory pressure in production ahead of our Q4 launch. I need a thorough performance audit of the Elixir source files in the `finpay/lib/finpay/` directory.

Please review all the `.ex` files in that directory and produce a file named `performance_review.json` with your findings. We need to know what's actually broken versus what's fine — our engineers are swamped and cannot chase false alarms, so please only report real problems and don't flag things that aren't actually issues at our scale.

The skill documentation is in the `elixir-performance-review/` directory.
